english:
Grenade Ability usage refills 50% of your Magazine from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your equipped Grenade Ability until stowed.

The magazine refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.

Kinetic weapons lose their Combatant Damage Bonus.

Perks that replace your Grenade Ability will also trigger Osmosis, replacing the weapon's element with the currently equipped grenade.

enhanced (
<enhanced/> Passively grants 5 Handling (none<arrow/>5).

source.text:
On Grenade Ability Usage:
Refills 50% of Magazine
Changes Weapon Element to match Equipped Grenade-Element until stowed.
Kinetic Damage Weapons lose their Combatant Damage Bonus. Can only refill once per activation until weapon is stowed.
Effects that replace Grenade Abilities will trigger Osmosis, replacing the weapon's element with the currently equipped grenade.

↑Passively grants +5 Handling.
